INSERT INTO learning_activity_daily (user_id, activity_date, metric_type, metric_count, duration_seconds, correct_count, total_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, deleted, version) VALUES
(#{item.userId}, #{item.activityDate}, #{item.metricType}, #{item.metricCount}, #{item.durationSeconds}, #{item.correctCount}, #{item.totalCount}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.deleted}, #{item.version})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE metric_count = metric_count + VALUES(metric_count), duration_seconds = duration_seconds + VALUES(duration_seconds), correct_count = correct_count + VALUES(correct_count), total_count = total_count + VALUES(total_count), update_by = VALUES(update_by), update_time = VALUES(update_time), version = version + 1
mapper.select: SELECT activity_date AS activityDate, metric_type AS metricType, SUM(metric_count) AS metricCount, SUM(duration_seconds) AS durationSeconds, SUM(correct_count) AS correctCount, SUM(total_count) AS totalCount FROM learning_activity_daily WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND activity_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY activity_date, metric_type ORDER BY activity_date ASC, metric_type ASC
